split_policy: Chronological training, calibration and test cohorts; freeze training labels before calibration/test starts; account for 28-day maturity plus reporting grace. No random split. No recycled export keys across independent exports.
fairness: Same eligible rows, app/version/policy/country/platform cohorts, labels, seed list and model capacity; nested feature ablations. Compare both full cohort and common lawful coverage subset; report coverage selection separately.

initial_model_plan.ltv: mean baseline and regularized linear baseline with train-only transforms
initial_model_plan.tree_optional: fixed small gradient-boosted tree budget after simple baseline
initial_model_plan.hyperparameter_budget: identical pre-registered search count; never tune on test

metrics_plan: Top10% high-value recall with tie rule
uncertainty_plan: Paired block bootstrap by independent install-date/ad-policy cohorts; fixed seeds and confidence level. Repeated people/clusters stay in same block at owner side. Report number of blocks; do not manufacture individual IID confidence with few cohorts.
auction_plan: Reuse auction/model first-price engine without modifying it; identical opportunities, outcome draws, budget, competitor prices, floor, tmax and pacing protocol. Any generated prices/counterfactual outcomes imply conditional simulation only.
causal_limit: Without true opportunity/price logs, known selection probabilities and overlap, do not report real policy ROAS or causal incrementality. Even logged propensity alone does not guarantee valid causal estimates.
no_vendor_claim: Neither observed synthetic benefit nor lack of benefit ranks Axon or Vector or identifies their production features/models.
